about.p1: I am Agnes, your consultant in astrology and kabbalistic numerology. For over fifteen years I have studied the skies, the numbers and the human soul to help you read your own journey with clarity.
about.p2: Each consultation is an intimate conversation: no generic horoscopes. I dive into your chart, listen to your questions and give back practical guidance, made for your life — and for the moment you are living right now.

terminal.r3: There is harmony between you, but it asks for patience: elements that complete each other need time to learn to dance.
terminal.r4: Your path number reveals creative strength and a mission tied to self-knowledge. The present year calls for courage to begin again.
